title: Run bounded typed context or deterministic analysis over a trace artifact

sourceArtifactRef.description: Existing immutable trace artifact resolved by the Runtime lease boundary.

kind.description: Closed ArkTrace context or deterministic analysis family.

timestampNs.description: Center timestamp for the reviewed 100 ms context/range window; mutually exclusive with startNs/endNs.

startNs.description: Inclusive range start; required together with endNs and mutually exclusive with timestampNs.

endNs.description: Exclusive range end; required together with startNs and greater than startNs.

processKey.description: Stable process internal identity; zero is the absent sentinel and is rejected.

pid.description: Operating-system process id to filter to, as recorded in the trace; omit for every process. Distinct from processKey, which is the trace's own internal identity.

threadKey.description: Stable thread internal identity; zero is the absent sentinel and is rejected.

tid.description: Operating-system thread id to filter to, as recorded in the trace; omit for every thread. Distinct from threadKey, which is the trace's own internal identity.

thresholdNs.description: Minimum long-slice duration for analysis kinds; absent means zero.

limit.description: Per-analysis section limit, additionally bounded by maxRows and maxEvents.

timeoutMs.description: Wall-clock budget for the analyzer process. The provider also derives its own process deadline from this, rounded up to whole seconds and capped at 120.

maxRows.description: Upper bound on rows the analyzer may return, applied on top of `limit`. Bounds the answer's size independently of how many the query would match.

maxEvents.description: Upper bound on trace events the analyzer may read while producing the answer. Bounds the work, where maxRows bounds the result.

maxOutputBytes.description: Upper bound on the analysis document's size in bytes. The analyzer fails rather than truncating, so a bound this small for the requested kind is a refusal, not a shorter answer.

steps.notes: Reads one immutable trace artifact and publishes one exact validated context/analysis JSON artifact.
